name: RewardValuationReceiptCandidateV1
purpose: Define how typed or multi-timescale reward value could become material-learning evidence without reopening caller authority over dimension, utility, confidence or causal contribution.

authority_law.material_valuation_must_be_produced_by: versioned bounded valuation producer whose exact code/model/config/calibration identity is receipt-bound
authority_law.material_learning_consumer_rule: verify exact terminal binding, source frontier, producer identity, policy identity, evidence digest, calibration identity and receipt integrity before any material update

valuation_entries.utility: bounded Real with declared scale semantics
valuation_entries.confidence: calibrated probability-like or explicitly non-probabilistic typed confidence
valuation_entries.horizon: FAST|MEDIUM|SLOW or future versioned horizon set

candidate_output.abstention: explicit supported result when producer lacks sufficient evidence
candidate_output.conflict_state: preserve incompatible valuation entries/producer disagreements rather than silently averaging them
candidate_output.receipt_hash: canonical hash over complete bound input/output/policy identity

invariants: same exact terminal receipt plus same frontier/evidence/producer/policy/calibration must replay to the same deterministic receipt when producer class is declared deterministic
caller mutation of dimension/utility/confidence/credit after production invalidates receipt
source-frontier drift invalidates currentness until revaluation or explicit policy-approved reuse is proven
policy-version drift changes receipt identity even if numeric outputs happen to match
unknown or unsupported reward dimension fails closed or abstains
conflicting typed valuations remain observable and cannot be collapsed by caller choice
valuation never creates EffectAuthorization, tool authority, truth authority or Frank Harness authority
binary TASK policy from PR 368 remains a simpler baseline, not a semantic prior that multi-dimensional candidates must imitate

mandatory_discriminators.test: mutate TASK to SAFETY after receipt production
mutate utility magnitude after receipt production
attach a valid valuation receipt to a different terminal receipt/effect
new authoritative DONE changes reward source frontier after valuation
same values under a different producer/policy version
two admissible producers/evidence classes disagree on typed value
rebuild from exact terminal/frontier/evidence/policy after restart
matched frozen episodes compare producer-owned typed/multiscale candidate to code-owned binary TASK baseline
NAcc/E-PQ original-baseline matched replay plus lesion/rescue/OOD/restart/resource comparison

strongest_counterhypothesis: A simpler scalar/binary outcome-derived reward with separate non-material salience/control channels may dominate typed material valuation once authority, calibration, resource, OOD and recovery costs are included. Multi-dimensional reward is therefore a candidate to beat the simpler baseline, not the assumed destination.
promotion_gate: producer identity is machine-verifiable and not caller-selected
all RV-01 through RV-08 authority/currentness/replay gates pass
RV-09 matched binary-vs-typed comparison demonstrates non-dominated benefit on frozen replay and held-out/OOD episodes
latency CPU RAM token/model-call and persistence amplification are measured
crash restart rollback and stale-frontier recovery pass
historical NAcc/E-PQ baseline plus lesion/rescue obligations are satisfied before replacement/fusion claims
ClayCode semantic execution is demonstrated on accepted target rather than inferred from Python-only reference behavior
explicitly_open: which reward dimensions deserve material status
utility scale and calibration semantics per dimension
whether fractional causal credit provides net benefit
whether multiple horizons should be explicit material state
which producer classes are sufficiently independent/trustworthy
whether scalar reward plus typed non-material control dominates multi-dimensional material reward
claims_not_made: any concrete dimension semantics are correct
